attributes.name: footer contact column layout
attributes.definition: How the footer's contact information (hours, address) is arranged spatially.

values.definition: Contact info divided into two side-by-side columns.
Contact info stacked in one column.
Different arrangement or no footer contact area.

attributes.name: multi-line block line-break treatment
attributes.definition: How multi-line text blocks such as addresses and hours are broken into lines.

values.definition: Lines separated by line-break elements inside a single text container.
Each line is its own paragraph, list item or element.
Content flows as one continuous line without breaks.
No multi-line address or hours block.
